resources.string: Local network access is off. Allow it so nearby devices can reach this proxy.

HTTP supports browsers and system proxies. SOCKS5 supports TCP clients. PAC provides automatic proxy setup.

Ports must be different and within 1024–65535, including disabled protocols. A valid edit is saved when you tap Done or leave the field.

After changing a port, update it on your client too.
Changing a port? Update your client settings too.
Sharing stopped. These ports are saved settings.
Authentication is on. Enter your username and password on the client.
Clients using this proxy may lose access. Turn off their proxy settings or remove the setup profile when you stop using this gateway. Settings and traffic history are preserved.

Settings, rules, recent changes and diagnostic logs are stored on this device. There is no account or usage analytics SDK.

Proxy traffic goes to the destinations requested by your clients. System DNS uses the selected network; enabled backup DNS can query Google, Cloudflare, Alibaba or Tencent over HTTPS. Subscriptions and diagnostic checks contact their corresponding services.

Exported settings can include rules and domain history; exported logs can include domains and client IP addresses. Proxy passwords are excluded from settings backups. Review exports before sharing them. Clear recent changes from Recent rule changes.
Rule saved. Retry from the client with a new connection.
Clear stored diagnostic logs? Export first if you need to keep the evidence.
The selected physical network is unavailable. Direct traffic does not fall back to VPN.
URLs keep only the host. Direct and Block rules appear in their corresponding lists.
The egress is temporarily isolated after failed checks. Review the network and logs.
A rule rejected this connection. Allow this host through the proxy to retain the default egress.
The upstream connection was established. This does not prove the page loaded successfully.
Use the recorded stage and client retry to verify the result. Missing records do not prove no request occurred.
This connection closed after transferring data. Confirm the page result on the client.
Search, sort and inspect the complete retained list
Enter a valid domain, URL, IP address or CIDR.
No matching retained records. Retry from the client; this does not prove there was no request.
No recent request details for this host. Traffic counters are independent of request records.
No saved quick rule changes yet.
Per-host overrides take precedence. Direct and Block lists remain available in Rules.
Only PAC is on. Clients using this PAC will connect directly.
Detailed request recording is off. Device and domain traffic counters remain available.
The rule changed again or could not be restored. Review its current settings.
Restored. Verify with a new connection.
The last 20 quick edits are saved on this device, including after a restart. Restore affects only that host and protects later edits. Verify changes with a new connection.
A later edit takes priority. This restore is currently unavailable.
Delete the saved change history? Your current rules will stay as they are.
Saved change history could not be read. Your current rules are unchanged.
Could not clear change history. Please try again.
Could not save. Your input is retained; try again.
The selected VPN is unavailable. Check egress and fallback settings.
This list is currently off. The saved rule will remain inactive until you enable the list in Rules.
The selected network disappeared. Sharing now uses the available networks; review your inbound selection.
Choose an inbound network to view the proxy IP.
This host has no retained per-host counter. Its traffic may be in Other or an expired entry; request records are shown separately.
